correctness.rationale: For Q=Quot_C^2(O_C^r), smooth connected complex projective C and r>=2, smoothness dim 2r follows Hom(K,F), Ext^1(K,F)=0 for zero-dimensional F. In a cyclic O_D-module chart with w=t-s1/2, the exchange involution sends B_j->-B_j for j=2..r and fixes s1,s2,A_j, so scheme fixed locus C^(2)xP^(r-1) with negative normal rank r-1. In a noncyclic two-framed chart F has multiplication T and vectors v3..vr; the action is T->tr(T)I-T and all v fixed, so fixed ideal is three traceless equations, geometrically CxGr(2,r), negative normal rank3. Every length-two module at a double point is cyclic or k_x^2; at distinct points invariance requires common quotient line, so the two charts exhaust the fixed scheme. Completed-local invariant rings yield transverse A^(r-1)/±1 and A^3/±1; the sign action in dimension three has determinant -1 and no pseudoreflection, hence quotient index2 non-Gorenstein. Euler fixed locus gives L=r*chi(Sym^2 C)+binom(r,2)*chi(C)=r(1-g)(r+2-2g). Independently checked 625 integer 2x2 matrices and 100 (r,g) cases, not a replacement for global Quot-chart geometry.
